name: qa-async-jobs
description: Background job and queue testing for Sidekiq, Celery, BullMQ, SQS, RabbitMQ and Kafka consumers, plus cron schedules and idempotency guarantees. A read-only critic agent (async-job-health-critic) flags missing retry limits, absent dead-letter routing, and other at-least-once reliability defects in queue and worker code.
